02WHY LOCAL

The fast lane
between your devices.

Local transfers avoid the round trip to the internet. The host is a small native C++ process, so the interface stays light while your files stay close.

01

Fast by proximity

Move files across the network you are already on—without uploading to a cloud service first.

02

Lightweight by design

A native C++ host starts quickly, uses modest resources, and leaves the browser to do the presenting.

03

Private by ownership

Choose the computer and disk where the workspace lives. Your data does not change hands.

03THE HANDOFF

One simple route

Drop it here.
Pick it up anywhere.

Stop messaging files to yourself. sSheila gives every trusted device one local destination for the things you need to move, remember, or finish.

04MORE THAN TRANSFER

The small things
that keep a day moving.

Files are only the beginning. The workspace gathers the fragments that usually end up scattered across apps.

→

Universal inbox

Files and thoughts from different devices arrive in one place.

↗

Markdown notes

Write, format, preview, and recover drafts without locking your work away.

□

Tasks + reminders

Turn unfinished thoughts into follow-ups that stay with the workspace.

⌕

Search + recovery

Find notes and files quickly, then restore deleted content from the recycle bin.

≋

Live updates

Changes appear on connected devices as the workspace changes.

∞

No client installation

Run sSheila once on the host. Every other device uses a browser.
